LESSON: MEDICINAL TREES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation (Srishti)
Topic 1.2: Medicinal Trees

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Medicinal Trees. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are medicinal plants beneficial to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use
2. name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
3. identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
   In simple words: practise until you can name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Medicinal Trees using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Medicinal Trees in the examples.
2. Explain Medicinal Trees to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Medicinal Trees.
4. Show that you can: identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Medicinal Trees using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Medicinal Trees important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching to participate in tree planting activity carried out in the school compound,
2. Communication and collaboration: Learner works collaboratively when collecting different leaves of medicinal plants available in their locality and make a scrapbook.
3. Life Skills: Learner learns developmental perspectives when creating a natural corner for medicinal plants.
4. Read the life histories of the four Enlightened Beings and social welfare,
5. Listen to stories of Enlightened Beings using Scriptures/a resource person/audio-visual device,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are medicinal plants beneficial to mankind?
2. Why is it necessary to use medicinal plants appropriately ?
3. Why is it important to nurture medicinal plants?
4. How do Enlightened Beings contribute to social welfare?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use
2. name the Enlightened Beings for familiarisation
3. identify the contributions of Enlightened Beings for spiritual well- being

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
